title: “The Hub”
content: I regularly end up in this place I call “The Hub.” It’s like a futuristic airport. High ceilings and lots of observation areas to watch the crafts. For context I lost my best friend not that long ago at 30 years old and we hadn’t been super close when it happened so I felt awful about it. The other night I was in the hub watching passengers off load from a futuristic craft. My buddy got off of it and when I talked to him and asked how he’d been he said “I’m great dude! It’s so awesome where I am now.” Woke up with CHILLS man. Woof.
